views.name: track_canonical
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Track.TrackId AS TrackId,
  Track.Milliseconds AS Milliseconds,
  (Track.Milliseconds / 60000.0) AS DurationMinutes,
  Track.AlbumId AS AlbumId,
  Track.GenreId AS GenreId,
  Track.MediaTypeId AS MediaTypeId,
  Track.Composer AS Composer,
  Track.Name AS Name
FROM Track
WHERE Track.TrackId IS NOT NULL
  AND Track.Milliseconds IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per Track with canonical/cleaned core attributes used for duration and joins (keeps only tracks with non-null id and milliseconds). Exposes raw duration in milliseconds and computed duration in minutes.

views.name: invoice_line_revenue
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  InvoiceLine.TrackId AS TrackId,
  SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue
FROM InvoiceLine
GROUP BY InvoiceLine.TrackId
views.description: InvoiceLine-level revenue measures per Track. One row per TrackId summing revenue (UnitPrice * Quantity) across invoice lines. Does not drop tracks without invoice lines (such tracks will be absent here but can be left-joined by consumers).

views.name: track_duration_stats_dataset
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MIN(Track.Milliseconds) AS MinMilliseconds,
  AVG(Track.Milliseconds) AS AvgMilliseconds,
  MAX(Track.Milliseconds) AS MaxMilliseconds,
  -- midpoint between Min and Avg
  (MIN(Track.Milliseconds) + AVG(Track.Milliseconds)) / 2.0 AS MidMinAvgMilliseconds,
  -- midpoint between Avg and Max
  (AVG(Track.Milliseconds) + MAX(Track.Milliseconds)) / 2.0 AS MidAvgMaxMilliseconds
FROM Track
WHERE Track.TrackId IS NOT NULL
  AND Track.Milliseconds IS NOT NULL
views.description: Dataset-wide duration statistics computed over all tracks (min, avg, max milliseconds). One row (scalar) summarizing the Track.Milliseconds distribution to support threshold computation for categories.
